scoring_justification: Full Monte Carlo simulation cannot be re‑run in the verifier; scoring compares agent‑reported absolute values and ratios against the paper’s experimental/tabulated reference, checks monotonic trend, and cross‑validates ratios against the absolute values artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold absolute backward yields (experiment) and electronic stopping powers (tabulated) from the paper’s Table 1, together with derived normalized ratios.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper’s Table 1 (experimental γ_B and tabulated dE/dx columns).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the published table; ratios computed according to equations (10) and (11) using the same data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published experimental/tabulated reference numbers that the paper’s CDW‑EIS model must approximate; they form the authoritative reproduction target.

outputs.description: Total backward electron yield and electronic stopping power for each projectile computed by the CDW-EIS model.
Normalized backward yield and stopping power ratios relative to C6+; these ratios isolate deviations from strict Q_P² scaling.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifacts are compared against hidden reference data using appropriate tolerances.
